Collapse fragments into molecules

Source: R/features.R
collapse_molecules.Rd

Fragments with haplotype A or B, sorted by cell, chromosome and start; a new molecule starts when start > cummax(end) + gap of the previous fragments of the same cell and chromosome; one vote per molecule for the majority haplotype (ties dropped); ps is the first fragment's phase set. The running maximum is computed per group with an integer offset (exact for coordinates below 2^53 / number of groups).

Usage

collapse_molecules(fr, gap = 2000)

Arguments

fr

fragments with cell, chrom, start, end, hap, ps; hap "A"/"B" (other labels dropped) or integer codes 1 / 2 (= A / B)

gap

maximal gap (bp) between fragments of one molecule

Value

data.table cell, chrom, start, end, ps, n_frag, hap (hap "A"/"B"), one row per molecule
